reviewer_scope: Independent source review of LockEffects, borrowed bank storage, raw BOOL32 transport, shared lifecycle counters and Entry integration fixture
conclusions: ACRT initialization dispatches through recovered 06707c and encoded runtime resolver; VCRT initialization dispatches through its distinct recovered 050c38 and plain cache
VCRT result explicitly converts int32 to uint32 before uint64, retaining low EAX without sign extension
LockPlatform owns or borrows real typed storage; bridge never casts an original VA or fabricates native critical-section storage
PtdEffects borrows the shared lock State and Effects used by ACRT, preserving separate ACRT and VCRT counters and their real recovered cleanup bodies
Entry composition fixture exercises process attach, thread attach/detach, process detach, 14 ACRT plus one VCRT locks and corresponding 15 deletions
No native critical-section operations, target DLL or game execution are introduced
provider_preconditions: ACRT InitializeEffects and LockPlatform operations must refer to the same ACRT bank; VCRT API Effects must operate on the bank objects returned by LockPlatform storage
All borrowed states and provider objects must outlive their bridge and callback use; FLS callback binding must remain valid through final release and late callbacks
State operations require the external serialization and count domains specified by the recovered lock module
